failure_derived_fresh_fact_debate.protocol_repair: Round 3/4 initial transcript was superseded because candidate identities drifted; only identity-locked Round 3b/4b is authoritative search-control transcript.

strategy_control_fresh_fact_debate.protocol_audit: Original Judge already preserved the frozen candidate IDs and is valid. The later identity-locked Judge is a redundant confirmation with the same zero-survivor outcome, not a repair.

lessons.title: Scope/granularity alone reduces to effect heterogeneity
lessons.summary: If granularity is observable pre-outcome, exposure-at-utility differences can be modeled by same-information effect heterogeneity plus security-utility control; granularity is an effect modifier, not yet a new longitudinal object.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require an observable structural variable that forces opposite ex-ante predictions from a scope-aware same-information CATE/constrained-optimization baseline under matched utility, attack surface, lineage, task and budget.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Give the simplest scope-aware effect-heterogeneity baseline exactly the same pre-outcome variables before claiming a new mechanism.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search equal-scope/equal-utility histories whose future hazard differs because of a structural longitudinal state absent from the heterogeneity baseline.

lessons.title: Modified evaluator data does not escape verifier exogeneity
lessons.summary: If the evolving channel controls the verifier or its training data, high self-scores with external degradation are already predicted by self-authored verification and self-generated-supervision information limits.
lessons.reopen_condition: Match verifier provenance, task truth, history and observations, then show modification dependency alone creates a prediction not expressible by verifier-exogeneity/information-limit models.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Treat evaluator, reward, judge and test-generator channels authored by the evolving object as endogenous until an external information boundary is shown.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for a verifier-dependency residual after evaluator ancestry and information access are exactly matched.

lessons.title: Long-horizon gain offset can be ordinary negative transfer
lessons.summary: Merging semantically related but behaviorally incompatible strategies already predicts stagnation/regression through negative transfer and nonmonotonic consolidation; longer horizon alone is not a new mechanism.
lessons.reopen_condition: Match abstraction scope, behavioral compatibility, replay outcomes, conflict structure and task distribution, then identify a longitudinal state variable predicting gain-offset sign beyond negative transfer.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Test the same-information negative-transfer/nonmonotonic-consolidation account before proposing a multi-round collapse principle.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search equal-compatibility/equal-conflict histories with different future gain-offset signs due to path-dependent state.

lessons.title: Multi-agent redundancy reduces to marginal information plus coordination cost
lessons.summary: Task-dependent gains and nonmonotonic agent-count scaling are expressible by submodular diversity/redundancy plus coordination overhead; overlap is a diagnostic, not automatically a new self-evolution primitive.
lessons.reopen_condition: Hold functional redundancy and coordination budget fixed while a self-evolution-specific variable yields a repeatable non-additive scaling prediction the same-information baseline cannot express.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Give submodular diversity and explicit coordination-cost models the same overlap, routing and budget information.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search equal-redundancy/equal-coordination lineages whose future scaling signs differ due to persistent lineage structure.

lessons.title: Do not infer a live-lineage curve from frozen benchmark campaigns
lessons.summary: Long live duration plus frozen campaign scores does not establish repeated benchmark measurements along that live lineage; combining them invents an unobserved trajectory.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require joinable repeated measurements along the same live lineage or a matched prospective replay that identifies the longitudinal trajectory.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Keep live duration, frozen evaluation campaign and repeated longitudinal measurement as distinct evidence objects.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Prefer sources with repeated same-lineage measurements rather than extrapolating from endpoint campaigns.

lessons.title: External failure does not reveal an unreported internal accept signal
lessons.summary: A poor external score can establish harmful modification but cannot by itself establish internal self-assessment or verifier miscalibration; that would invent an unobserved variable.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require an internal accept/self-evaluation signal with provenance joinable to external outcome on the same update unit.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Every internal variable in a causal story must map to a source field, released trace or independently executable measurement.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search systems releasing both internal commit scores and external sealed outcomes for the same updates.

lessons.title: Cross-source longitudinal claims need matched intervention surfaces
lessons.summary: Self-harness/core rewrites and task-repository training-algorithm edits act on different causal surfaces; similar self-improvement language cannot define one regime transition without a tested transport mapping.
lessons.reopen_condition: Use sources sharing intervention surface and longitudinal endpoint, or provide a formal transport mapping that is itself testable.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Freeze substrate, intervention surface, unit, endpoint and time axis before cross-source synthesis; reject analogy-only joins.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Find independent systems modifying the same persistent surface under comparable repeated evaluation.

lessons.title: Provider/support censoring is not a scientific negative result
lessons.summary: Three anchored lanes were not completed because provider support was unavailable. Completed lane failures stand, while censored lanes remain resumable and must not become scientific STOPs.
lessons.reopen_condition: Resume only ASSUMPTION_BREAK, IDENTIFIABILITY_GAP and NEW_CAPABILITY_QUESTION when a valid provider route exists; completed anchored lanes require an operator change to rerun.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Track support failures independently from scientific dispositions and preserve exact lane-level resume boundaries.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Resume only censored lanes; any survivor must still pass source grounding, reduction and ProblemGate.

lessons.title: Intervention-identified pair effects do not make one factorization a new object
lessons.summary: If a generic unrestricted second-order predictor receives the identical singleton/joint interventions, descriptors, task motifs, graph structure and budget, an additive-plus-residual q factorization is only a parameterization choice. Beating an additive baseline proves nonadditivity, not the necessity of the factorization. Fresh E2-Explainer evidence also occupies causal edge masking, critical-subgraph attribution and amortized communication pruning.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require an independently observable communication state or intervention variable that yields an ex-ante prediction a same-data unrestricted pairwise/nonlinear graph-utility model cannot express; another decomposition of pair effects is insufficient.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Before claiming a structured interaction model as novelty, give an unrestricted same-information interaction predictor the identical intervention outcomes and graph descriptors.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for communication phenomena where identical observed singleton and joint effects imply different future outcomes because of a longitudinal state not present in ordinary graph utility or causal edge attribution.

lessons.title: Residual prediction plus clustering absorbs interaction-signature quotient algebra
lessons.summary: With identical pair/triple intervention residual targets, uncertainty supervision, identity-free features and storage budget, a direct residual-to-clustering method can form the same compression groups without quotient algebra. Thresholded interaction-signature similarity is also not automatically transitive, so quotient terminology can hide order-dependent clustering rather than create an independently observable scientific object.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require an independently testable algebraic or behavioral invariant whose predictions differ from same-supervision residual regression plus global clustering; merely enforcing transitive closure or changing clustering geometry is insufficient.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Any proposed quotient/equivalence memory object must prove reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, merge-order invariance, and value beyond direct clustering on the same learned representation.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for memory operations whose correctness depends on an executable invariant preserved under composition, not on how residual vectors are clustered.

lessons.title: Evaluator-environment information gaps reduce to proxy misspecification and distribution shift
lessons.summary: A fixed evaluator that omits execution-environment variables does not by itself create a new self-evolution object. Under information parity, proxy-reward misspecification and distribution-shift models can condition failure risk on how informative evaluator-visible features are about environment-conditioned truth and predict the same degradation.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require a source-grounded structural constraint where two systems have identical evaluator-visible and environment-visible pre-outcome information but make different future-improvement predictions beyond proxy misspecification/domain-shift models.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Do not claim evaluator blindness as a new primitive until the strongest proxy-misspecification/distribution-shift model receives the same feature sets and information-gap descriptors.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for matched evaluator/environment information states whose failure differs because of a distinct longitudinal control structure rather than missing features.

lessons.title: Frozen designer plus memory removal is compound negative transfer unless a residual survives
lessons.summary: A super-additive performance collapse after jointly freezing an environment designer and removing its memory is expressible as compound distributional mismatch and negative transfer. A factorial interaction alone identifies non-additivity, not a new self-evolution mechanism.
lessons.reopen_condition: Match generated-task distribution, designer adaptation state, memory information, learner state and training budget, then require a source-grounded variable that forces an outcome not expressible by same-information negative-transfer/domain-generalization models.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Treat multi-component ablation interactions as compound distribution shift/negative transfer first; non-additivity alone is not novelty.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for equal-distribution/equal-memory-information designer states with different future learner behavior caused by an explicit persistent control variable.

lessons.title: Persistent-autonomy break-even is fixed-cost amortization, not a phase transition
lessons.summary: When specialization pays a one-time promotion cost and saves a known amount per future service, the apparent autonomy threshold is exactly the deterministic break-even point FS/(G-M). Calling the zero crossing a threshold or cliff does not create a new mechanism.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require an independently observed non-amortization state variable that changes specialization value after matching fixed promotion cost, future service count distribution, per-service savings and uncertainty.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Before proposing a persistence threshold, calculate the fixed-cost break-even model with identical cost and service-count information.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for matched promotion economics where identical expected amortization yields different longitudinal value because of a distinct behavioral state.

lessons.title: Confidence retry thresholds reduce to cost-sensitive operating-point selection
lessons.summary: Varying a confidence threshold trades unnecessary retries against propagated failures. With identical confidence distributions, failure costs and retry costs, standard decision theory predicts the optimal operating point and any U-shaped total-cost curve; threshold tuning is not a new self-evolution primitive.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require a source-grounded state variable that makes two transactions with identical confidence, retry/failure costs, execution graph and available actions require different optimal retry decisions beyond a same-information cost-sensitive policy.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Give the decision-theoretic threshold baseline the same confidence distribution, costs and action set before claiming an agent-specific retry mechanism.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for matched confidence/cost states where persistent lineage changes the meaning or consequence of retry rather than merely shifting the optimal threshold.

lessons.title: Debate candidate identity must be locked across proposer, critic, rebuttal and judge
lessons.summary: The first rebuttal/judge pass drifted from the frozen candidate IDs to invented aliases. Those rounds were superseded and only identity-locked Round 3b/4b may be used. Debate reasoning is not auditable if roles silently switch scientific objects between rounds.
lessons.reopen_condition: A future debate may proceed only when every round preserves the exact frozen candidate IDs or records an explicit parent->child mutation mapping validated before judging.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Machine-check exact candidate-ID continuity after every debate round; fail closed before Judge if identities drift or unmapped aliases appear.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Use identity-locked transcripts so scientific reductions attach to the intended object rather than a model-generated alias.

lessons.title: Strategy lock-in reduces to phased search/action-support allocation unless a residual survives
lessons.summary: An agent that chooses a high-level strategy early and spends the remaining budget on local adjustment is predicted by a phased global-then-local search procedure. A post-hoc lock-in point is not a new causal state if the same-information baseline receives the same global/local action support and budget schedule.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require matched agents with identical strategy action support, global/local search budget, evidence transcript, current strategy, compute and proposal interface, yet a source-grounded persistent state forces different ex-ante strategy-revision decisions.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Before naming strategy inertia/lock-in, give a phased local/global search or non-convex basin baseline the identical search-action support and budget schedule.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for equal search-support/equal-budget trajectories where strategy revision differs because an independently observed persistent control state changes what is writable or revisable.

lessons.title: Harness commitment with retention risk is a stability-plasticity constrained decision
lessons.summary: Current improvement, historical retention and validity are ordinary multi-criteria inputs to a continual-learning commitment rule. If the baseline receives the same retention-risk estimate, a Pareto/constrained stability-plasticity controller predicts the same reject/commit behavior.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require two candidate updates matched on current gain, historical retention risk, validity, component interactions and budget where a distinct harness-specific structural state forces different commit decisions beyond same-information constrained optimization.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Never compare a retention-aware gate against an improvement-only straw baseline; the mature baseline must receive the identical retention and validity signals.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for harness updates with identical gain/retention/validity observables but different future control consequences due to a structural write or observability boundary.

lessons.title: Weak-over-strong oversight is not new when the same rubric supervision trains the baseline
lessons.summary: A weaker judge can discriminate outputs from a stronger generator when supplied decomposed rubric supervision; this is compatible with scalable oversight and supervised detection. Denying the comparator the rubric labels creates a false novelty gap.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require a matched oversight setting where candidate and strongest weak-judge/scalable-oversight baseline receive identical outputs, rubrics, labels, decomposition, confidence and compute, yet a source-grounded longitudinal state forces different verification decisions.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Match supervision and decomposition information before interpreting weaker-judge success as a new oversight principle.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for longitudinal oversight changes under identical judge supervision rather than generator-versus-discriminator capability asymmetry.

lessons.title: Event-aligned manager updates reduce to learned option termination under information parity
lessons.summary: A learned state-dependent manager update trigger inferred from primitive latent trajectories is already represented by event-triggered/semi-Markov hierarchical control and learned option termination. Beating fixed-K scheduling does not establish a new longitudinal self-evolution object.
lessons.reopen_condition: Require matched hierarchical controllers with identical latent trajectory, reward, learned termination capacity and update frequency budget where a source-grounded self-evolution state forces a different next-update decision than the strongest learned event-trigger baseline.
lessons.reusable_precheck: Compare learned event timing to a learned state-dependent termination baseline, not only fixed or heuristic schedules.
lessons.opposite_search_seed: Search for a persistent state that changes the semantics or authority of event-triggered updates rather than the timing rule itself.
